headline: The traced circuits got closer to the real maps
lede: Comet Drift GP's Daytona and Laguna-inspired courses have been creeping back toward their published references since the world tripled — this shift pulled the spread fork legs and keyhole pinch onto the traced line and tightened the shape caps to match.

notes.text: Sandbank's centerline now averages 1.39% of the box from the real Daytona road course (was 1.93%); Corkscomb 1.86% from Laguna Seca (was 2.79%), with its worst local deviation down from 18.6% to 18.0% — the keyhole pinch is visibly tighter.

New scripts/comet-retighten.mjs hill-climbs the control points toward the map line under gate parity (radius, wall crossings, leg spacing, straight window, Corkscomb signature), integer-snapped so what gets validated is exactly what ships.
Proof it can fail: replaying the old spread measures 18.6% against the new 18.5% cap and goes red. Full cometcheck green — autopilot wins every seed, bump caps and the straight-charge gate included.
Filed #1679: cometcheck --mutate has been crashing on main (URL-instead-of-path in mutateguard) because the mutate flow isn't in any CI job — same silent-rot class as watchcheck.
